create_form.title: Compose a form
create_form.description: Write a new instrument. It starts as a draft whatever the request says, and every lifecycle stamp on it is the store's to set. A standing instrument, which a person fills in as often as they like, never keeps its opening and closing times, and may name where each send lands: thread for a chat thread with the agent, case for a case on the board. Whether it is standing and where it lands are chosen here and never change.

register_forms.title: Search forms
register_forms.description: A page of instruments, narrowed by title, group and state, with how many prompts and how many people answered each. The totals count everything matched, not just the page. Respondents are counted in each instrument's current period, or in the period named by period_key, keyed by the day it opened.

list_waiting_forms.title: Forms waiting for me
list_waiting_forms.description: The open instruments that reached any group the caller is in, soonest closing first, each with the group that sent it, how many prompts it asks, when it closes, which of the caller's groups it reached, which groups the caller has sent as, which groups it was sent to that the caller is in and has not yet sent as, and whether the caller has answered as every one of them. It carries nobody else's figures. The groups come from the mount, never from the request, and a mount that supplies none reaches nobody.

args.description: The caller, from the session.
A language tag to read the titles in. Each instrument with a reviewed title in that language is listed under it; an unknown or unreviewed language, or none, lists the original title.

list_answered_forms.title: Forms I answered
list_answered_forms.description: Every instrument the caller has an answer on, open or closed, newest sent first, each with the group that sent it, when it was sent, its window, where it has got to, whether it can still be answered, and when the caller first answered and last edited. It carries nobody else's figures. The caller comes from the session, never from the request.

args.description: The caller, from the session.
A language tag to read the titles in. Each instrument with a reviewed title in that language is listed under it; an unknown or unreviewed language, or none, lists the original title.

get_form.title: Read form
get_form.description: Read one instrument: its title, its window, its audience and where it has got to.

args.description: The instrument to read.
A language tag to read the texts in. Each text with a reviewed translation in that language is served in it; an unknown or unreviewed language, or none, serves the original text.

update_form.title: Edit form
update_form.description: Change a draft's title, its window, its audience and how it is collected. Nothing else about it is editable, not whether it is standing nor where its sends land, and it stops being editable once it leaves draft.

args.description: The instrument to edit.

delete_form.title: Delete form
delete_form.description: Remove an instrument and everything composed into it. A form that has been published cannot be deleted, because people have answered it.

args.description: The instrument to remove.

submit_form.title: Send for a decision
submit_form.description: Hand a draft to whoever clears it, opening a round that waits for an answer.

args.description: The instrument being sent.
Who is sending it.

withdraw_form.title: Take it back
withdraw_form.description: Pull an instrument back to draft before or after it was cleared, closing the round that was waiting.

args.description: The instrument being pulled back.
Who is pulling it back.

publish_form.title: Open for answers
publish_form.description: Start taking answers. A public instrument gets its shareable link here; a member one reaches every group it was aimed at. Publishing twice changes nothing.

args.description: The instrument to open.
The token the shareable link should carry, for a public instrument. Refused if another link already holds it.
The office or group it is sent on behalf of, shown to whoever it reaches. Optional, one line, at most 120 characters.

returns.description: The shareable link, empty for a member-audience instrument.

close_form.title: Stop taking answers
close_form.description: Close an open instrument. Closing twice changes nothing.

args.description: The instrument to close.
Who is closing it.

publish_results.title: Publish a form's report
publish_results.description: Record the report on what a closed instrument collected: where it sits and at which commit, both supplied by the host. It is readable to the groups the publisher chooses, any group of the agency, and the groups inside them; with none chosen it goes to every group the instrument was aimed at. It sets when the results were published. Publishing again records the next version. An instrument that is not closed is refused.

args.description: The closed instrument the report is about.
Where the report sits in the repository that holds it.
The commit that holds this version of it.
The groups to publish it to, any group of the agency. Optional; omitted, it goes to every group the instrument was aimed at.

read_latest_results.title: Read a form's report
read_latest_results.description: Where the newest report on an instrument sits, for a caller in a group it was published to or a group inside one, as the host names the caller's groups. A form with no report, and one whose report went to none of the caller's groups, answer exactly as a missing one.

args.description: The instrument whose report to read.

approve_form.title: Clear a form
approve_form.description: Decide the open round in favour, which clears the instrument to be published.

args.description: The instrument awaiting a decision.
Anything they want recorded with it.

approve_form_slot.title: Grant one approval slot
approve_form_slot.description: Grant one of the approval slots the instrument declares in the open round. The round clears it once every slot is granted, each by a different approver.

args.description: The instrument awaiting a decision.
Which declared approval slot this grants.
Anything they want recorded with it.

refuse_form.title: Refuse a form
refuse_form.description: Decide the open round against, sending the instrument back to draft. A refusal has to say why.

args.description: The instrument awaiting a decision.
Why it was refused. Required.

list_approvals.title: Decision history
list_approvals.description: Every round one instrument has been through, most recent first.

args.description: The instrument whose history to read.

list_awaiting_approval.title: Waiting on a decision
list_awaiting_approval.description: Every instrument anywhere that is waiting to be cleared, the longest wait first.

args.description: How many to return. Absent or zero returns all of them.

add_question.title: Add a question
add_question.description: Append a prompt, and the choices it offers, to a draft. Its position and its version are the store's to set.

args.description: The instrument to append to.

returns.description: The choices it offers, in the order they will be shown.

list_questions.title: List questions
list_questions.description: Every version of every prompt on one instrument, in the order they are asked.

args.description: The instrument whose prompts to read.
A language tag to read the texts in. Each text with a reviewed translation in that language is served in it; an unknown or unreviewed language, or none, serves the original text.

update_question.title: Rewrite a question
update_question.description: Replace a draft prompt's wording and its whole set of choices. The old choices are removed rather than merged, so their ids stop resolving.

args.description: The instrument the prompt belongs to.
The prompt to rewrite.

remove_question.title: Remove a question
remove_question.description: Remove a draft prompt and its choices. The prompts after it move up one place. Refused once the instrument has left draft.

args.description: The instrument the prompt belongs to.
The prompt to remove.

move_question.title: Move a question
move_question.description: Put a draft prompt at a position, counted from 1, and renumber the others around it. Refused once the instrument has left draft.

args.description: The instrument the prompt belongs to.
The prompt to move.
Where the prompt should be asked, counted from 1.

list_options.title: List choices
list_options.description: The choices one prompt offers, in the order they are shown.

args.description: The instrument the prompt belongs to. Part of the address, not of the call.
The prompt whose choices to read.
A language tag to read the texts in. Each text with a reviewed translation in that language is served in it; an unknown or unreviewed language, or none, serves the original text.

add_option.title: Add a choice
add_option.description: Append one more choice to a prompt, whatever state its instrument is in. It is the one content edit a published instrument allows, because adding a choice cannot invalidate an answer already given.

args.description: The instrument the prompt belongs to. Part of the address, not of the call.
The prompt to add to.
The choice as it should be shown.

version_question.title: Supersede a question
version_question.description: Replace a published prompt with a new one, leaving the old prompt and the answers already given against it untouched. Only the version nothing has superseded may be superseded.

args.description: The instrument the prompt belongs to. Part of the address, not of the call.
The prompt to supersede.

add_target.title: Aim at a group
add_target.description: Aim a draft member-audience instrument at its one group, optionally reaching the groups beneath it. An instrument is aimed at one group only, so a second aim is refused; a public instrument carries no aims.

args.description: The instrument being aimed.

list_targets.title: List aims
list_targets.description: Every group one instrument is aimed at, oldest aim first.

args.description: The instrument whose aims to read.

remove_target.title: Stop aiming at a group
remove_target.description: Remove one of a draft's aims.

args.description: The instrument the aim belongs to.
The aim to remove.

list_propagation.title: List what it reached
list_propagation.description: Every group one instrument reached, and how far each got with it.

args.description: The instrument whose spread to read.

rollup_form.title: How far it got
rollup_form.description: How many groups an instrument reached, how many took it up, and which of them never did.

args.description: The instrument to summarise.

pick_up_form.title: Take it up
pick_up_form.description: Record a group taking up an instrument it was reached with. A group that was never reached is refused rather than recorded.

args.description: The instrument being taken up.
The group taking it up.

submit_answers.title: Answer a form
submit_answers.description: Send every answer at once, as one group the instrument was aimed at that the caller belongs to. They are all checked before any is written, so one bad answer leaves nothing behind, and answering again as the same group edits what was already given as it rather than doubling it. A standing instrument keeps every send as its own record instead, and each answer returned carries that record's id as send_id.

args.description: The instrument being answered.
The group being answered as. Absent picks the first group the instrument was aimed at that the caller belongs to.
The language tag the caller answered in, recorded on the send. Absent records none.

The period of a repeating instrument this send was opened for, keyed by the day it opened. The send is refused when that period is no longer open, even because the next one opened. Absent sends to the period open now.
One answer per prompt being answered.

list_answers.title: Read my answers
list_answers.description: What the caller answered on one instrument, in the order the prompts were asked. Nobody else's answers are reachable here.

args.description: The instrument answered.

list_previous_answers.title: Read my previous period's answers
list_previous_answers.description: What the caller answered on a repeating instrument in the period before the current one, in the order the prompts were asked, for copying into this period. Empty when the instrument does not repeat or has no earlier period.

args.description: The repeating instrument answered.

list_all_answers.title: Read everyone's answers
list_all_answers.description: Every answer given on one instrument, grouped by who gave it and in the order the prompts were asked, optionally narrowed to one person. An operator's read, gated apart from a member's read of their own.

args.description: The instrument answered.
Only this person's answers. Absent reads everyone's.
Only the answers given in this period of a repeating instrument, keyed by the day it opened. Absent reads every period.

get_my_submission.title: Have I sent this form
get_my_submission.description: Whether the caller has sent their answers to one instrument, when they first sent and last sent again, and how many answers the send carried. A send with no answers still counts as sent. Never sent answers not found. Nobody else's send is reachable here.

args.description: The instrument sent to.

get_my_send.title: Read one of my sends
get_my_send.description: One send the caller made to one instrument, named by its id, with the answers it carried in the order the prompts were asked. For an instrument that keeps every send as its own record, this is how each one is read back; the ids are on the caller's list of what they answered. A send that is not the caller's answers exactly as one that does not exist.

args.description: The instrument sent to.
The send, as listed among what the caller answered.

list_submissions.title: Who has sent this form
list_submissions.description: Everyone who has sent their answers to one instrument, first sender first, each with when they sent and how many answers the send carried, so somebody who sent nothing still shows as having responded. Optionally narrowed to one person. An operator's read, gated like everyone's answers.

args.description: The instrument sent to.
Only this person's send. Absent reads everyone's.
Only the sends made in this period of a repeating instrument, keyed by the day it opened. Absent reads every period.

mark_paid.title: Mark a send paid or not paid
mark_paid.description: The organiser records that the person who sent this instrument has paid, or that they have not. The mark is kept on the person's own send beside their answers, so sending again before the close does not clear it. Nothing here takes a payment: a person records it. Never sent answers not found.

args.description: The instrument sent to.
The person whose send is marked.
True marks the send paid, false marks it not paid.

list_missed.title: Who missed a period
list_missed.description: Everyone in a repeating instrument's audience who sent nothing in one period that has closed, each with the group that reached them. The audience is the members of the instrument's target groups, as the host lists them. An operator's read, gated like everyone's answers.

args.description: The repeating instrument.
The closed period, keyed by the day it opened.

list_declarations.title: Which groups respondents said they are in
list_declarations.description: Every group an anonymous respondent declared on one instrument through its shareable link, oldest first, each with the group picked from the list or the text typed where none fitted. An operator's read, gated like everyone's answers.

args.description: The instrument declared on.

count_declarations.title: How many respondents declared each group
count_declarations.description: How many anonymous respondents declared each group on one instrument through its shareable link, one count per group, in group order. Declarations made by typed text alone count under an empty group. An operator's read, gated like everyone's answers.

args.description: The instrument declared on.

open_public_link.title: Open a shared link
open_public_link.description: Follow a shareable link to the instrument it opens. An unknown token, a retired link and an instrument that is not open all answer the same way, so nothing can be learned by trying tokens.

args.description: The token the link carries.

public_link_questions.title: Read a shared link's prompts
public_link_questions.description: Every current prompt of the instrument a shareable link opens, with its choices, in the order they are asked, so a person can answer before they have an account. Nothing about any other instrument, and no answers. An unknown token, a retired link and an instrument that is not open all answer the same way, so nothing can be learned by trying tokens.

args.description: The token the link carries.
A language tag to read the prompts and choices in. Each text with a reviewed translation in that language is served in it; an unknown or unreviewed language, or none, serves the original text.

register_respondent.title: Start answering anonymously
register_respondent.description: Claim or reclaim the token this device answers under. A token that already exists comes back as it stands rather than being rewritten.

args.description: The token the link carries.
The token this device holds. Absent mints a new one.

declare_chapter.title: Say which group you are in
declare_chapter.description: Record which group an anonymous respondent says they belong to, for the instrument this link opens. Saying it again replaces what was said before.

args.description: The token the link carries.
Who is saying it.
The group they picked from the list.
What they typed instead, where no group on the list fitted.

claim_respondent.title: Answer as myself
claim_respondent.description: Tie the token this device answered under to the signed-in caller, once they sign in at the end of answering through a link. From then on the caller may read and answer the instrument this link opens, and every other one the token was claimed through or named a group for, though they are in none of its groups and declared nothing. A token already tied to somebody else is refused.

args.description: The token the link carries.
The token this device answered under.

put_translation.title: Put a translation
put_translation.description: Write one text of an instrument, of one of its prompts or of one of its choices in another language, or replace the one already held for that text and language. A text sent unreviewed is not served until it is put again marked reviewed. A text held by another instrument or another kind of object is refused.

args.description: The instrument the text belongs to.

list_translations.title: List translations
list_translations.description: Every text of one instrument in every other language, reviewed or not, for review.

args.description: The instrument whose texts to read.

list_reviewed_translations.title: Reviewed translations
list_reviewed_translations.description: The reviewed texts of one instrument in one language: what a read in that language shows in place of the original.

args.description: The instrument whose texts to read.
The language tag to read.

list_translation_languages.title: Languages available
list_translation_languages.description: The languages one instrument has at least one reviewed text in, sorted.

args.description: The instrument whose languages to read.
